evidence.quote: MASSIVE, Must-See Apartment Featuring: Three Windowed Home Offices, 2.5 Baths, a Large Open Kitchen, 2 Over-sized Living Areas and 2 Walk-in Closets! Flex 5!

evidence.detail: The unit's 2021 ad 3596172 states "MASSIVE 2000 Sq. Ft. Apartment".
The unit's 2021 ad lists the same 2.5 baths, large open kitchen, two over-sized living areas and two walk-in closets, and states 2,000 sq ft.
Sonnet read of all the unit's ads: a flex-5 apartment of about 2,000 sq ft at 45 Wall Street with no size in this record.
The unit's 2020 ad asks $2,662 as a 1 bedroom. The building's other studio ads of 2019 ask $2,245 to $3,095.
Sonnet read of the unit's ads: the whole description is "test.", so the record is a test listing. Its $6,000 ask is more than twice the unit's other ask and the building's studios.
The unit's 2022 and 2026 ads ask $4,100 and $4,650 as a 1 bedroom. The building's other 1-bedroom ads from 2019-07 to 2020-07 ask $3,100 to $3,800.
Sonnet read of the unit's ads: a one-line description with a $9,999 ask, more than twice every other ask of the unit and of the building's 1 bedrooms, so the ask is a placeholder or a typo.
